key.name: visible
key.summary: Show Crêpe
key.description: State of the quick settings toggle. Off hides her without disabling the extension.

key.name: sprite-pack
key.summary: Sprite pack she is drawn from
key.description: The name of a folder under $XDG_DATA_HOME/crepe/packs (~/.local/share/crepe/packs) holding a pack.json and her animations. Empty means the built-in pack, Crêpe. A pack that cannot be loaded falls back to Crêpe.

key.name: scale
key.summary: Sprite scale
key.description: Screen pixels per sprite pixel, before the HiDPI factor. 3 gives a 240 px Crêpe.

key.name: sleep-after-minutes
key.summary: Minutes of inactivity before she falls asleep

key.name: crawl
key.summary: Let her crawl sideways now and then

key.name: crawl-interval-minutes
key.summary: Average minutes between two crawls of her own
key.description: Each wait is picked between two thirds and four thirds of this. 0 means she never crawls by herself; "crawl" stays the master switch.

key.name: talk
key.summary: Let her talk
key.description: Show a short line from assets/repliques.json in a bubble above her now and then.

key.name: crepe-speech
key.summary: Share of her lines said in Crêpe, with the sentence in small print below
key.description: In percent. Every word becomes a "crêpe", values such as times, counts and titles aside; the line in clear shows in small print under it. Reminders, recaps, meeting summaries and replies from the daemon or from scripts are always in clear. 0 means always in clear, 100 always in Crêpe.

key.name: comment-interval-minutes
key.summary: Average minutes between two idle remarks
key.description: Each wait is picked between two thirds and four thirds of this. 0 means no remark for no reason.

key.name: homesick-percent
key.summary: Chance, in percent, that she crawls back after being dropped while calm
key.description: Doubled while she is annoyed. While she sulks she always goes back.

key.name: react-to-notifications
key.summary: Jump when a notification arrives

key.name: react-to-windows
key.summary: React to the title of the focused window

key.name: error-keywords
key.summary: Words that make her facepalm
key.description: Matched case-insensitively against notification titles, notification bodies and window titles.

key.name: success-keywords
key.summary: Words that make her give a thumbs up

key.name: busy-keywords
key.summary: Words that mean a window is busy with a long task
key.description: Matched case-insensitively against the focused window's title. When a title loses them after two minutes or more, she gives a thumbs up.

key.name: perch
key.summary: Perch on the focused window
key.description: Sit on the right end of the focused window's title bar and follow it, instead of staying at her own spot.

key.name: eyes-follow
key.summary: Follow the pointer with her eyes
key.description: While she rests, her eyes turn towards the pointer. Close to her, or left still for a few seconds, she looks straight ahead.

key.name: dodge
key.summary: Move out of the focused window's way
key.description: When more than a quarter of her frame sits over the focused window, she crawls aside on her row, and back once the window has gone. Only with layer set to top.

key.name: layer
key.summary: Where she lives on the stage
key.description: "top": over every window, like the shell's own chrome. "behind": under every window, just above the desktop; her speech bubble stays on top.

key.name: bedtime-hour
key.summary: Hour after which she falls asleep by herself
key.description: From this hour until 6 in the morning she goes to bed after her next fidget. 0 turns it off.

key.name: pause-reminder-minutes
key.summary: Minutes of continuous activity before she suggests a break
key.description: Three idle minutes count as a break. 0 turns it off.

key.name: react-to-music
key.summary: Comment on music
key.description: Follow the first MPRIS media player on the session bus and remark on new tracks now and then.

key.name: brain
key.summary: Talk with the conversation daemon
key.description: When crepe-daemon runs on the session bus, offer to talk to her from the menu and the shortcut. Without the daemon nothing changes.

key.name: brain-remarks
key.summary: Let the daemon write some idle remarks
key.description: One idle remark in three is asked from the daemon instead of picked from assets/repliques.json. Each one costs a request.

key.name: talk-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the box to talk to her

key.name: home-monitor
key.summary: Monitor she lives on
key.description: Where it is from the primary monitor: beside it ("left", "right") when they share some height, otherwise above or below it ("up", "down"). When that monitor is not plugged in she lives on the primary one, and crawls back once it is.

key.name: fraction-x
key.summary: Horizontal position
key.description: Where she sits across the work area of her monitor (home-monitor): 0 is the left edge, 1 the right edge.

key.name: fraction-y
key.summary: Vertical position
key.description: Where she sits down the work area of her monitor (home-monitor): 0 is the top edge, 1 the bottom edge. She crawls at this height.

key.name: focus-minutes
key.summary: Length of a focus session, in minutes

key.name: focus-dnd
key.summary: Turn notification banners off during a focus session
key.description: Sets org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-banners to false for the session, then back to what it was.

key.name: hide-during-screencast
key.summary: Hide while the screen is shared or recorded
key.description: She leaves the stage, bubble and outfits included, for as long as a screen sharing or a screen recording goes on.

key.name: quiet-during-calls
key.summary: Stay quiet while a microphone or a camera is in use
key.description: No bubble and no reaction to scripts while an application records from the microphone or uses a camera; what scripts said is summed up in one line afterwards.

key.name: recap
key.summary: Evening recap
key.description: Once a day, at recap-hour, she sums up the day from her counters.

key.name: recap-hour
key.summary: Hour of the evening recap

key.name: last-recap-date
key.summary: Day of the last recap, as YYYY-MM-DD
key.description: Internal: keeps a re-login from repeating the day's recap.

key.name: stats
key.summary: Daily counters
key.description: Internal: JSON object of the last 30 days, keyed by YYYY-MM-DD. Written at most once a minute.

key.name: outfits
key.summary: Let her dress up
key.description: Sleep mask, knit hat in winter, sunglasses in summer, party hat on her birthday, a drink and a deckchair on Friday evenings. Off, she wears nothing, outfit-override included.

key.name: outfit-override
key.summary: Outfit she wears whatever the date
key.description: One id of assets/tenues.json, worn alone instead of what the rules say, for showing them off. Empty follows the rules. The sleep mask still only shows while she sleeps.

key.name: birthday
key.summary: Her birthday, as MM-DD
key.description: She wears a party hat all that day. Anything that is not a date of the year means no birthday.

key.name: last-outfit-lines
key.summary: Day each outfit last got its line
key.description: Internal: JSON object of outfit ids to YYYY-MM-DD, so she remarks on an outfit once a day at most, across logins.

key.name: reminders
key.summary: Pending reminders
key.description: Internal: JSON array of {id, at (epoch milliseconds), text}, at most 20, so a re-login does not lose them. Overdue ones are delivered when she starts.

key.name: ink
key.summary: Spit ink when she is furious
key.description: A few dark splats on the monitor she is on when she storms off, or once per sulk when she is poked meanwhile. They take no clicks and fade away in about twenty seconds.

key.name: last-week-bilan
key.summary: Day of the last weekly bilan, as YYYY-MM-DD
key.description: Internal: on Friday from 17:00, if the recap is on, she sums the week up once; this keeps a re-login from repeating it.

key.name: last-gag-date
key.summary: Day she last brought up a fact of the past week, as YYYY-MM-DD
key.description: Internal: at most once a day, an idle remark is replaced by a notable fact of the last seven days.
